parameters.query: WITH current_week AS ( SELECT tk.keyword, kr.position, kr.search_volume, kr.checked_at FROM tracked_keywords tk JOIN keyword_rankings kr ON kr.keyword_id = tk.id WHERE kr.checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND tk.is_active = true ), previous_week AS ( SELECT tk.keyword, kr.position FROM tracked_keywords tk JOIN keyword_rankings kr ON kr.keyword_id = tk.id WHERE kr.checked_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND tk.is_active = true ) SELECT cw.keyword, cw.position as current_position, pw.position as previous_position, cw.position - COALESCE(pw.position, cw.position) as position_change, cw.search_volume FROM current_week cw LEFT JOIN previous_week pw ON cw.keyword = pw.keyword ORDER BY cw.search_volume DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_backlinks, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as new_backlinks, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = false AND last_checked > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as lost_backlinks, ROUND(AVG(domain_rating)) as avg_dr, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE domain_rating >= 40) as high_quality_count FROM backlinks

SELECT url, status_code, response_time_ms, issues, checked_at FROM site_health_checks WHERE checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND (status_code >= 400 OR response_time_ms > 3000) ORDER BY checked_at DESC
